title: It doesn't work.
text: It doesn't work.. I was suprised that a product from such a good brand would fail to perform.  Most of the drying mats I've had work, by absorbing the excess water and allowing it to evsporate.  Two full days later and water was still present on the dishes.  I bought another mat from Joseph Joseph and have been much happier.

product_metadata.title: All-Clad Textiles Dish Drying Mat, 1-Pack, Rainfall
features: Safe and sound. Preserve countertops from water damage while protecting delicate dishes and glassware from chipping and scratching while drying.
Reversible. Ultra-absorbent thick foam keeps counters dry while polyester mesh prevents condensation and fog build-up in glassware.
Bigger and better. Oversized 16” in. x 28” in. (40 cm by 71 cm) is the perfect fit for larger pots and pans.
Get coordinated. Coordinate your drying mat with the rest of the All-Clad collection of kitchen textiles, including pot holders, oven mitts, aprons, towels, and more.
description: An essential for any kitchen, especially when space is at a premium, the All-Clad® Dish Drying Mat is a safe landing pad for wet dishes, glassware, and oversized pots and pans to ensure they remain free of chips and scratches. This durable oversized mat measures 16” in. x 28” in. (40 cm by 71 cm) and is designed with a super-absorbent thick foam that keeps counters dry while polyester mesh prevents condensation and fog build-up inside of glasses. All-Clad® Dish Drying Mats offer several folding options that allow for convenient storage and are available in a variety of stylish colors to compliment your taste. Machine wash for easy care.
